Senior Backend Engineer — Fintech Startup (Series B)

About the Role:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our growing engineering team. You will design, build, and scale our core payment processing infrastructure serving millions of transactions daily.

Required Skills:
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI or Django preferred)
- Experience with PostgreSQL and Redis
- Familiarity with AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, SQS)
- Experience with Docker and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
- Understanding of RESTful API design and microservices architecture
- Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated testing
- Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar)

Preferred Skills:
- Experience with financial systems or payment processing
- Knowledge of TypeScript and React for full-stack contributions
- Familiarity with Terraform or infrastructure-as-code tools
- Experience with observability tools (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus)
- Understanding of SOC2 compliance and security best practices

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement scalable backend services for payment processing
- Optimize database queries and caching strategies for high-throughput systems
- Collaborate with product and frontend teams to deliver end-to-end features
- Participate in on-call rotation and incident response
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering culture

Benefits:
- Competitive salary ($180K-$220K) + equity
- Remote-first culture
- Health, dental, vision insurance
- Unlimited PTO
- $2,000 annual learning budget
